summary: Sprint C — Score Mémoire 5-axes: fully validated backend + frontend. 5/5 pytest tests pass covering schema, auth requirement, cold-start (fresh user), post-attempt update with cold_start flag, and /progression/me regression. Frontend Progression page renders memory-score-card, overall block, radar SVG pentagon, 5 axis buttons, and focus panel — click on axis updates focus text correctly. All existing sections (hero, badges, mastery) still render.

issues: Recharts logs a benign 'width(-1) height(-1)' warning at first paint before ResponsiveContainer measures — chart renders correctly, not blocking, but could be avoided by giving the wrapper an explicit min-height on md screens or an aspect ratio.

critical_code_review_comments: memory_score.py _axis_regularite: `distinct('created_at', ...)` on attempts returns full ISO timestamps, so 'set(days)' logic depends on the slice [:10] — currently handled correctly, but the initial `days = set(dates_d)` includes daily date_keys (YYYY-MM-DD) while attempts ISO strings are truncated only via the loop; low-risk but the two sources should be normalized in one place.

COLD_START_ATTEMPTS=3 threshold: culture axis pct is scaled by (n/3) below threshold, so 1 attempt with 5/5 correct yields ~33 pts, which matches the intent, but the label 'cold_start' is exposed via `detail` only and not surfaced on the axis object itself; frontend correctly falls back to detail.cold_start.
MemoryScoreRadar.jsx: on API failure the component returns null silently (no error state). Consider a lightweight error placeholder for observability.

No caching / memoization on the endpoint — recomputes 5 aggregations per call. For heavy users this may cost ~5 Mongo round-trips per page render. Acceptable at current scale; consider a 30s in-memory cache if it becomes hot.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin path); cold-start UI not verified due to registration flow selector, but backend cold-start test covers behavior
